plugins.name: intake-form
plugins.description: Turn a batch of decisions or an underspecified request into a standalone HTML form from a JSON spec. Each question can say why it matters, what is at stake and what the agent recommends; the answers come back as an agent-ready export and are filed as the project's decisions of record. Nothing is pre-selected, every question can be skipped with a reason, and the reviewer can tell you the form itself asked the wrong questions.
